segments.name: High-Pressure Controls
segments.evidence: The High-Pressure Controls segment designs, engineers, manufacturers, and supplies components for transportation and industrial applications, using gaseous fuels such as hydrogen.

segments.name: Heavy-Duty OEM
products: HPDI related fuel system solutions and components
segments.evidence: The Heavy-Duty OEM segment represents historical results from our heavy-duty business for the period January 1, 2024, until the formation of the Cespira joint venture which occurred on June 3, 2024.

segments.name: Cespira
segments.description: Joint venture with Volvo that designs, assembles and supplies HPDI fuel systems and engineering services to engine manufacturers and commercial vehicle OEMs.
segments.evidence: Cespira designs, assembles, and supplies LNG HPDI 2.0 fuel systems, related components, and engineering services to engine manufacturers and commercial vehicle OEMs.

changes.text: In 2025, Westport sold its Light-Duty segment and now reports three reportable segments.
changes.evidence: On July 29, 2025, the Company sold its Light-Duty segment to the Purchaser (note 5).

changes.text: In 2024, Westport and Volvo formed the Cespira joint venture to commercialize HPDI fuel system technology.
changes.evidence: On July 5, 2024, we officially launched "Cespira", a joint venture between Westport and Volvo Group focused on promoting, developing, and further accelerating the commercialization of the HPDI TM fuel system technology.

changes.text: In 2025, the Heavy-Duty OEM segment's transitional services agreement with Cespira ended.
changes.evidence: On June 30, 2025, the transitional services agreement (TSA) ended.
